content.title: How Urban Outfitters’ Nuuly Stole the Show From Rent the Runway
content.summary: Rent the Runway  might have introduced young consumers to the idea of renting their wardrobes.  Nuuly, a unit of  Urban Outfitters  seems to be the one that is actually making it work.  “Rental only works if you already have scale,” said  Simeon Siegel,  former retail analyst at BMO Capital Markets.

content.title: Rent the Runway CEO on customer loyalty, tariffs, & competition
content.description:
Rent the Runway (RENT) stock is skyrocketing after the company hit an all-time high in active subscribers in its last quarter. Jennifer Hyman, Rent the Runway (RENT) co-founder and CEO, joins Wealth with Brad Smith to discuss the company's earnings results, how customer loyalty contributed to the company's strong performance, and differentiation amid competition.
